patch_description: Remove the four controlled phase rotations that reuse the collective parameter. They do not improve validation accuracy or validation loss over the simpler prior circuits, while the current design takes twice as many steps to converge. Retaining the shared RY layer and proven parallel CZ matching preserves the minimum one-parameter-per-repetition economy and local correlations, while reducing gate count and depth and avoiding conflicting gradient contributions from using the same angle for both collective rotations and controlled phases.
